task: ae.proto protobuf-style wire codec with schema language and unknown-field preservation
reasoning_summary: Designed a Varint/Kind/Schema/Msg/Codec stack where Msg is immutable and Codec is a strict decoder that preserves unknown and wire-type-mismatched fields byte-exactly. Tests were written first from public protobuf guide vectors, then a BigInteger-based independent reference encoder checked 3000 random messages, plus truncation and bit-flip fuzzing asserting only DecodeException escapes. 48 tests passed on the first run and a 12-mutant pass killed all mutants.
